issues.description: The template's ray_sphere_intersect header declares a function named check_sphere_hit(), but the implementation (ray_sphere_intersect.cpp) defines ray_sphere_intersect(). The rest of the code (main.cpp) calls ray_sphere_intersect(), and the solution repository's header declares ray_sphere_intersect() as well. This name/signature mismatch in the template header will cause compile-time errors and confuse students about the intended API (they will see a declaration that does not match the implementation or the calls elsewhere).
issues.suggested_fix: Make the header declaration match the implementation and usage. Replace the declaration of check_sphere_hit(...) in template_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h with the function prototype: bool ray_sphere_intersect(const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center, const float radius); (or alternatively rename the implementation to check_sphere_hit and update all callers). Prefer matching the solution's ray_sphere_intersect name so template, implementation, and main.cpp are consistent.

issues.description: The template header declares the sphere-intersection function as check_sphere_hit(...) while the implementation and all usages expect ray_sphere_intersect(...). The solution repository consistently uses ray_sphere_intersect(...). This naming mismatch in the template (declaration vs. implementation/usage) creates a direct mapping and compilation problem: students including the header will not find a matching declaration for ray_sphere_intersect, causing build errors and confusion about which function name to implement or call.
issues.suggested_fix: In the template header (template_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h) rename the declaration check_sphere_hit(...) to ray_sphere_intersect(...) with the same signature so it matches the implementation and usages (and aligns with the solution). This removes ambiguity and prevents compilation/lookup errors. Example: replace 'bool check_sphere_hit(...);' with 'bool ray_sphere_intersect(...);'.
